facts.value: It is extremely important that you submit the documents required for the issuance of your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Upload the required documents through My ASU. The upload tool on My ASU only allows the upload of each document type once.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: If you upload financial documents that do not cover the full funding needed as shown on the financial guarantee, you will be asked to submit additional documentation to demonstrate the full funding, which will delay the issuance of your I-20.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Once ASU has received all documents required to issue an I-20 and has verified that they are complete, you will receive an email with a link to download your I-20 from the Document Portal in My ASU.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: Once received, you should print the I-20 and sign the document. You will not receive a physical I-20 via mail.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: The email regarding your I-20 will be sent to your non-ASU personal email address. Be sure to check it often, including junk and spam folders.

metadata.chunk_title: What we want you to know + Helpful reminder

facts.value: If you are unable to submit the documentation needed to receive an I-20 from ASU or are unable to obtain your F1 visa in time to arrive by the start of the semester of your admission, contact [international admissions email](mailto:[email protected]).
